frontend: B24 + midpoint sigma1.5/head_epoch03, unchanged standard output
auxiliary: Exactly one fixed half-shrink view after native RResize, before Normalize/Pad, PortIsotropicShrink prob1 scale(.5,.5). Actual sx/sy restored by native pipeline, not assumed nominal .5. Original coordinates already restored in cached predictions; never divide sizes again.
evidence: max(abs(log L_main-log L_aux),abs(log S_main-log S_aux)), plus binary auxiliary missing. Canonical sorted edges. No learned image reference, geometry averaging, score/angle feature from auxiliary, clipping, sequence routing or temporal state.
fitting_roles: Reuse sealed TRAIN identity-only roles: fit1942, probe492, legacy64, purged60. Fit only standard-present fit rows; no center-error eligibility filter. Both arms zero init, class balance, mean/std from fit, L2.1, Newton max100, tol1e-8. One 3-feature fair refit control and one 5-feature candidate; no sweeps.
probe: Previously exposed original TRAIN probe, not independent validation. 95% per-domain/video correct retention with a single whole-tie global cutoff on probe is supervised diagnostic only, not a deliverable policy. Fit/legacy/purged similarly reported without gating or selecting weights.
TRAIN_continue: Probe: overall and Real same-count FA strictly below refit_simple, frozen full_simple and score; all other domains/videos FA no worse, conservative control minimum FA at boundary tie; every group correct retention >=95%, longest FR no worse versus same-count controls. Report matched CR controls, AUROC/AP and all FA/FR/ED/CR/missing runs. Failure stops before VAL auxiliary inference, no retry or scale search.
VAL_if_TRAIN_passes: Collect only one matching half-scale auxiliary for all887 VAL frames. Keep fitted models, no refit or coefficient search. Global supervised VAL cutoff ensuring every-domain/video correct retention >=95%, disclose calibration not independent validation. Require overall FA strictly better than same-count refit_simple/full_simple/score, all groups FA nonincrease with conservative ties and longest FR nonincrease. Freeze before any exposed TEST report; no automatic deployment.
protections: Only size risk/flag may change. Original OBB, score, count, center flag, angle risk/flag and depth API unchanged. No original output -> no size judgment even if auxiliary output exists; original center never removed by auxiliary failure. GT is offline only.
data_reads: Sealed mixed scored_TRAIN_VAL gzip bytes and roles read for selection of TRAIN rows; no VAL fitting, scoring or metrics in capability stage. No TEST file opened.
limitations: Consistency cannot detect shared errors across scales.
Top1 corresponds to the same image, not guaranteed same physical object across scales.
Midpoint was trained using these two scales; this is not unseen augmentation or independent model evidence.
Video frames/related views are not independent samples; no safety guarantee.
Probe has only few errors and omits VAL-only seq07 weather; failure is limited evidence, not proof all TTA fails.
Future online implementation needs one additional detector+midpoint pass; cached CPU runtime is not deployment latency.
